state: mem:GeminiProvider.models (static catalog: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash default, gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
toplevel: Static model catalog with prices/context windows pinned by ProviderModelCatalogTests; id = .gemini; RequestBody nested Encodable structs use synthesized encoding except FunctionDeclaration (custom encode in an extension at the file end). The URL session, cache-marker split, <live_state> envelope, error-body draining and status mapping are ProviderHTTP's.

Maps chat turns to Gemini contents (user→"user", everything else→"model"), appending the live_state block to the text of the last user turn; if there is no user turn and the block is non-empty it inserts a synthetic user turn at index 0; then appends a model/user content pair per non-empty tool round.

branches.effect: role "user"; otherwise "model" (assistant and any other role become model).

branches.cond: splice (this is the last user turn and liveStateBlock non-empty)
branches.effect: text = turn.text + liveStateBlock; otherwise turn.text unchanged.

branches.cond: no user message exists and liveStateBlock non-empty
branches.effect: inserts a standalone user content holding only the live-state block at position 0; otherwise nothing.

branches.cond: for each tool round, skipping empty rounds
branches.effect: appends toolRoundContents(round) (model call turn + user response turn); empty rounds contribute nothing.

units.does: Builds one tool round as a model content of functionCall parts (args parsed from inputJSON, thought signature recovered from the tool-use id) followed by a user content of functionResponse parts whose response is {"result": <parsed resultJSON>}, or {"result": "<the text>"} when the result is not JSON (a plain-text resolver error reaches the model as written).

branches.effect: returns base id only; otherwise base + "#sig:" + signature.

units.does: Recovers the thought signature from a synthetic tool-use id: the substring after the first "#sig:".

units.does: Reads the Gemini key from Keychain, splits the system prompt at the cache marker (ProviderHTTP.splitOnCacheMarker: stable half → systemInstruction, variable half + contextRendered → ProviderHTTP.liveStateEnvelope on the last user turn), builds tool declarations, POSTs via ProviderHTTP.streamSession, maps non-2xx to errors, parses the SSE stream (which throws on an error or blocked-prompt chunk), then yields .done.

Reads SSE lines, parses each data: JSON chunk; an {"error":...} chunk (ProviderHTTP.streamFailure) or a blocked-prompt chunk (blockedPrompt) throws, so a failed or blocked reply reaches the chat as an AIProviderError rather than an empty success; otherwise yields text deltas / synthesized tool uses per content part, keeps the last usageMetadata and yields one .usage after the stream ends.
